risk_summary: The excerpt presents a generally constructive and investment-grade credit profile, supported by regulated utility operations, rate-recovery mechanisms, improving ratings, and quantified infrastructure investment. Key risks include dependence on favorable regulatory outcomes, unresolved environmental issues, potential loss of the Gallup contract, and exposure to wholesale-market earnings from PVNGS Unit 3. Disclosure is fairly detailed but includes substantial strategic and boilerplate language and some unresolved forward-looking matters.
